nigeria_note: Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations dated 16 Nov, updated at 11:07 and 12:00 WAT and rechecked at 13:37 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location differences rather than force a single quote. The wider EUR buy range is corroborated by both observations and documented. CBN selling benchmarks are dated 13 Nov, the latest fully published central-bank table. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1. Indicative only; not FX advice.
